change: Missing hip origins use an interpolated hip-to-box offset within continuous observed track segments. Reliable hip origins, no-hip fallback, network size and initialization are preserved.
limitations: Exploratory paired comparison on previously inspected footage. Fold/seed observations are dependent; deviations and win counts are descriptive, not confidence intervals or significance tests. Interpolation uses the whole clip and can still be affected by box jitter, incorrect joints and track errors. Detection masks and confidence remain available. A feature correction does not prove external generalization.
